items.title: What data was selectively recovered?
assumptions: The restored 2025-26 profiles and clean baselines are early-season fallbacks, not current-season measurements.

source.label: DEC-058 recovery audit

metricDefinitions.label: Recovered rows
metricDefinitions.definition: Recovered rows count validated unique-key records activated or preserved as season-specific snapshots by the DEC-058 recovery.

filters: Excluded: code, models, OOF predictions, picks, slips, live injuries, and projections
caveats: Historical lines and NBA box scores were already supersets of the ZIP and were not rewritten.
The current 2026-27 blowout index remained untouched; only the 2025-26 index was archived.

evidenceFlow.title: Grain and integrity checks
evidenceFlow.detail: All restored tables have zero blank keys and zero duplicate keys; the position union has zero assignment conflicts; every restored hash matches the manifest.

evidenceFlow.title: Production isolation
evidenceFlow.detail: All 56 active production-model hashes still match the DEC-057 recovery manifest.

sourceRoles.role: Source archive containing the validated 2025-26 cache records.

sourceRoles.role: Records source, backup, destination, row-count, and SHA-256 evidence for the recovery.
